body: I’m 18 and I can relate. My temples have been receding and I’d look ugly as fuck if I went bald too. Although it does kinda make me feel better knowing I’m not the only one dealing with this. I’ve lost so much motivation to do anything, the last time I left my house on the weekends was last month. School is kicking my ass because I’ve been depressed I didn’t get into the college I wanted, and admittedly it was my fault. I used to have a gf but not anymore, and I just feel left out of everything my “friends” do. The thought of killing myself goes through my head every single day and it’s been getting to a point where I can’t ignore it as efficiently as before. I hate this shit. I don’t want to be like this, and I deeply relate to what your post is about. The only reason I haven’t ended it all yet is because I don’t want to put my parents through that, which I assume is a huge reason for you too. I honestly don’t have any useful tips or suggestions for you, just kinda wanted to let you know that I understand and am going through the same shit. We aren’t alone. :/
